content: निर्याणम् .²1 Exit, issue, setting out, departure. .²2 Vanishing, disappearing. .²3 Dying, death. .²4 Eternal emancipation, final beatitude. .²5 The outer corner of the eye of an elephant; वारणं निर्याणभागेऽभिघ्नन् <ls>Dk. 97</ls>; निर्याणनिर्यदसृजं चलितं निषादी <ls>Śi. 5. 41</ls>; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 6. 9</ls>, <ls n="Mātaṅga L.">12. 19</ls>. .²6 A rope for tying cattle or the feet of a calf, a foot-rope in general; निर्याणहस्तस्य पुरो दुधुक्षतः <ls>Śi. 12. 41</ls>. .²7 Iron. .²8 Decamping (of an army) .²9 Going out (of cattle to the pasture ground). .²10 A road leading out of a town.
